issues.title: Wire GossipSub into accumulated integration
issues.description: Wire GossipSub networking into the DAG-BFT service in accumulated. Currently service.go passes nil,nil to consensus.NewNode() for host and pubsub, which disables multi-node networking. Fix: 1) Add Host() method to p2p.Node, 2) Create GossipSub in dagbft.go, 3) Pass to ServiceConfig, 4) Pass to consensus.NewNode in service.go

issues.title: Run 7 accumulated validators with DAG-BFT for 30 minutes
issues.description:
## THIS IS NOT A CONSENSUS-TESTNET TEST

**DO NOT** run cmd/consensus-testnet tests. That was already done and tests only the consensus layer in isolation.

**THIS TASK** validates the full accumulated integration with DAG-BFT:
- accumulated binary (not consensus-testnet)
- DAGBFTService in cmd/accumulated/run/dagbft.go
- internal/node/dagbft/service.go
- GossipSub wiring from issue #3813

## WHAT YOU MUST RUN

7 `accumulated` validator nodes where EACH validator runs:
- 1 BVN (Block Validator Network) partition
- 1 DN (Directory Network) partition

This means 7 validators = 14 total partitions (7 BVNs + 7 DNs), all using DAG-BFT consensus instead of CometBFT.

## WHY THIS IS DIFFERENT

The consensus-testnet only tests pkg/consensus in isolation. This task tests:
- Full accumulated binary startup
- DAGBFTService integration with the executor
- Cross-partition anchoring via DN
- Real Accumulate transaction processing (not test transactions)
- BPT state management
- The GossipSub wiring done in #3813

## STEPS

1. Configure 7 accumulated nodes with DAG-BFT enabled
2. Each node runs both BVN and DN partitions
3. Start all 7 validators
4. Submit real Accumulate transactions for 30 minutes
5. Verify BPT roots match across all validators
6. Document results

## SUCCESS CRITERIA

- [ ] 7 accumulated validators running (not consensus-testnet)
- [ ] Each validator runs BVN + DN partitions
- [ ] DAG-BFT consensus (not CometBFT)
- [ ] 30 minutes runtime without crash
- [ ] BPT roots match across validators
- [ ] Cross-partition anchoring works
